candidate.scope: Read-only MCP and bounded CLI reads; no synchronization, mutation MCP or codec release.

implementation.disclosure: Registered checks verify implementation; a passing CI run is not release approval. Timing artifacts describe their recorded source snapshot, not every subsequent revision.

deterministic.registration_rule: Add focused nonignored integration tests under tests/; the whole suite covers CLI/RPC compatibility, read/MCP behavior, migrations and durable mutations without a second test-name inventory.

structural.scope: Bounded hydration, query counts/plans, cursor budgets and serialization allocations; deterministic assertions, not absolute latency gates.

instrumentation.scope: Small generated 100-item fixture; provenance, raw samples, SQL counters, online snapshot and durable-write verification.

ci.comparison_policy: Scheduled/manual measurements use only generated fixtures, reuse the ignored Phase C comparison harness and upload JSON/provenance. They do not run on ordinary PRs or auto-approve a release.

phase_c.scope: Historical Phase C production bounded-read versus preserved pre-B baseline comparison, 100/10k/100k seed 2003, 20 warm samples; not a new Phase D measurement.

phase_d.scope: Persistent-process startup versus one-shot CLI; warm mixed calls, concurrent CLI writes, RSS/WAL observations and cursor/validator restart, 100/10k/100k seed 2003. Custom process instrumentation is not a configured MCP host smoke.
phase_d.source_disclosure: Measured dirty c5605ce8611ece07f0c64e7ff09cd97eec1b0407 plus the exact parent src/mcp.rs typed optional error-ID fix and final src/mcp/tools.rs live-pagination descriptions. Each artifact includes unchanged start/end production input hashes and executable hashes. These are final planned production-code measurements, not a clean final Git revision claim or a measurement of later edits.

real_configured_mcp_host.reason: Codex desktop 26.930.51102 (build 13100), MCP client 0.160.0, executed the configured disposable-store workflows and retained-token restart check. Sanitized application-owned traffic is recorded; operator signoff remains pending.
real_configured_mcp_host.registration_rule: Record a repository-relative JSON evidence path with kind=real_configured_mcp_host, host_name, host_version, sanitized configuration, source_revision, executed_at and workflows.<name>.{status=passed,transcript=<repository-relative file>}. Never include host credentials.

model_tokens.disclosure: No model token measurements are available. Response bytes and synthetic/process workflows are not token evidence; no token-saving claim is approved.

rehearsal.recipe: Unchanged SQL/checksums produce schema 2 with production capture history/idempotency. SQLite online backup to pristine root; independent candidate upgraded through production open to schema 3; rollback from pristine backup into another independent root.
rehearsal.later_writes: The candidate-only write is absent after rollback. Restoring a pre-upgrade backup discards later writes unless separately preserved/reconciled.

old_binary.scope: Archived historical schema-2 source built in the attached worktree; real old/candidate executable CLI get/history, capture replay, revision-checked approval and write/read reopening on disposable roots. Old executable refuses upgraded schema 3; pristine backup restores schema 2 and pre-upgrade content.
old_binary.gap: 45ed7fc is the historical schema-2 baseline identified by the existing runbook, not a retained operator-approved production executable. No approved-production old revision was supplied. Operators must still inventory/rehearse their actual retained binary/configuration before a live rollout.

rehearsal.operator_only: Inventory and stop live writers/servers; obtain explicit authorization for any real-store upgrade or replacement; verify backups and restart configured hosts. This automated rehearsal never replaces an active store or performs in-place downmigration.

release_gate.policy: Required recorded timing provenance plus a real configured host make the candidate reviewable, not automatically approved. Operator review of compatibility, evidence and the per-release runbook remains required.
